So, David. Well, just a moment before I  start, on behalf of myself and all the club,  
we want to congratulate Liverpool Football Club  for the Premier League victory. Well deserved,  
no doubt about that, fantastic team. So during  one year, like it happened the last four years,  
they're going to retain the title and hopefully  next season we can be better. To compete until  
the end of this season could not be possible. So  Liverpool, congratulations. Congratulations. After  
all the problems you've had this season with the  team, what does it say about the group of players  
that you've managed to get to the final for the  third year running? Yeah, seven semi-finals of  
FA Cup finals speak highly, the volume so,  so high about this generation of players,  
this club in itself. We are really pleased that  we are there. I said many times the season has not  
been good because we define the season good or not  is the Premier League, the consistency and always  
we have been that always, but this season could  not happen. But at the same time, we try to avoid  
the damage that, especially the most important  thing, qualification for the Champions League.  
You have to be calm now, recover because this is  steady of this grass, always the fatigue is there.  
But you have five days against a team like Wolves,  like coming for five, six victories in a row,  
and he's playing really, really good. And  we have four finals and after, of course,  
really, I'm very, very pleased to play against  Crystal Palace that yesterday when you saw the  
game, how proof, how good they are. Hi, Pep. It's  just me. And some of the players who played today,  
like Lewis, O'Reilly, are we seeing a bit of the  future maybe of your team going forward? They  
cannot do it alone. So their own players always  perform well. Yeah, both have been extraordinary,  
not for the goal from Rico and Nico that, you  know, again, they play really, really good. Yeah,  
really pleased. I think Rico helped us a lot  as a full-back in bird, full-back inside,  
but I think his perfect position is a pocket  because he move in the small spaces like Phil,  
that ability in the smaller spaces have  to be aggressive in the next action. So,  
Rico, since Land arrived with us, always have  been really, really good. Did you mention Phil?  
Did you leave Phil and De Bruyne on the bench just  as selection? They're not injured or anything? No,  
no, no. I tried to make the selection rotate  a little bit, but for the way we want to play,  
I decide for that players and step by step, step  by step, Phil will be back like he was an amazing  
player. You talked a lot this season about control  and maybe not having control of games as much as  
you would have liked, but today you had Kovačić,  more four players really in that central midfield  
in the first half. Do you think that gave you that  kind of stability that you've been looking for in  
the control? Our process was a little bit better  and they make follow man marking in the middle and  
they're so aggressive. With them, with this type  of game, the only we miss and after that we could  
break after that process, we could break the lines  in the middle and have to be more aggressive and  
we miss it that a little bit. But we either didn't  want to be a game open game with a second-half or  
Wolves or give to White. And the first place of  course help us in the first minute score a goal,  
but even with that we continue to play that tempo.  We had a chance, the final third, we were not  
clever enough, brilliant enough. They had chances  in the post, but we have three or four conditions  
that we didn't even shoot that we should have done  it. But yeah, in general, the moments and actions  
from, of course, we are lucky in the post. We  cannot deny that. They had chances, of course, we  
cannot deny that. But I think the game in general,  a part of the action that they had was really well  
played and we cannot forget. So they have one  game at hand. If they win it, they are in front  
of us in the Premier League. So they have done it  better. So we know which opening we are facing.  
In the team with more clean sheets in the Premier  League and we couldn't too, we had more chances.  
So yeah, really pleased to be in the final again.  Hi Pep, just on Rico, when did you kind of decide  
that you were going to start him in midfield  and how pleased are you? Yesterday or the day  
before. I started to see my mind two days ago. And  today we decide yesterday anyway. And he's not had  
an easy season. He's played a lot. He's not played  too much in recent weeks, but bringing him back in  
for a game of this importance just kind of shows  how much you trust him. I don't have any doubt.  
There are some players there, always I speak to  them, so they are judged or they believe I don't  
appreciate them just for the fact I don't play, I  don't play. And Rico, I give you the hand too. To  
show his quality and he proved it, so I don't have  any that he's got. He's took till I'm playing in  
different positions, left-back, right-back, in  bird. He's not a player like Mateo or maybe up  
and downs, but he's a player had the quality to  do it, so yeah, really pleased in that sense. Hi,  
Pep, staying on Rico, do you think playing as  number 10 is a position we can see him moving? No,  
it's a pocket. It's pocket position, eight, 10.  The smallest, he moves really well in most pieces.  
When sometimes when we play not good like season,  it's not necessary, but when we play really good  
and control and drop the opponents in the final  third, players can move in the smaller spaces.  
It's really important. And Rico is one of the best  I ever seen. He's one of the best. His reception,  
his controls, his rhythm is really good. And after  that, he just scored a fantastic goal, but had  
this quality. I remember we played this season two  or three times in the post, and actions he missed  
being in the penalty spot. He's a guy in the final  third after that, he likes to be there, and yeah,  
he proved it today. The sort of box midfield  that you're playing, is that here to stay? Is  
that how you want it? The sort of the way you're  playing in midfield at the moment with the two in  
front of the city, is that here to stay? No, today  and tomorrow, yesterday, but maybe tomorrow, no.  
But you've done it, but you've done it a  couple of times in the last couple of weeks  
as well, sort of similar things, so. Yeah, I won't  do it, but do you know going to happen if I use it  
a lot, a lot, a lot, the opponent is going to take  a tricky, it's going to find enough to have to do  
it again, have to do something differently to see  where the space is more clever, more clear. But  
this is true, especially the build-up with these  four players, help us to have more process. It  
just after that, you have to look, and the moment  we contact for the full-backs or for wingers or  
for that, a little bit more aggressive in that.  But we will improve for the timing. Martin. If  
you can win the FA Cup and finish in the top  five and qualify for the Champions League,  
how would that be a successful season given? No. I  said my fans, no, season had not been good. We had  
1,000 million points behind Liverpool. Come on. So  it's not good. Season had not been good. Champions  
League, look at the Champions League. One how many  in one game, two games we win, but always we were  
a machine in that they were not being good, but  of course the damage will be meaner, so it's not  
going to confuse the fact qualified champions will  win the FA Cup, all respect for Crystal Palace.  
In order to confuse it, the season have been  good. No, I had to take the decision, the club  
had to take the decision, the right ones to next  season be better. No, no, no. Okay, thank you.
